visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a large indoor industrial facility featuring a massive blue metal gantry crane structure positioned over a calm, reflective pool of water. Yellow safety barriers line the edge of the water. (2) Transition to a man with short dark hair and glasses wearing a black button-down shirt, standing in front of a blurred background of bookshelves and warm indoor lighting; he uses active hand gestures and exhibits an enthusiastic facial expression with wide eyes and a moving mouth. (3) Graphic overlays appear, including a gold circular diagram with Chinese characters and a separate frame showing two domestic cats interacting with a metal Newton's cradle on a table. (4) White mathematical equations and text boxes with black backgrounds appear on screen, accompanied by the man pointing towards them. (5) A montage follows: a slow-motion shot of a red apple being struck and shattering, followed by a large ground explosion with fire and smoke. (6) Visuals shift to a high-angle view of ocean waves crashing and a screen capture of a Google Maps search showing 'Ocean Engineering Center'. (7) Schematic diagrams of a rectangular pool with dimensions (36m, 30m, 10m) are shown in white lines over water footage. (8) Close-up shots of yellow and silver mechanical components (wave makers) moving rhythmically along the pool's edge, creating artificial waves. (9) Footage of a water park bucket dumping water and wind turbines spinning on a snowy, pink-hued landscape at dusk.

(2) A synthesized 'Whoosh' SFX plays as a new visual concept is introduced. (3) A sharp 'Ding' chime sounds, highlighting a mathematical term. (4) Sound of rhythmic liquid splashing and rushing water textures are layered into the mix as the pool is shown. (5) A muffled percussive impact 'Thud' occurs during the apple smashing sequence, followed by a broadband 'Boom' explosion effect. (6) Frequent 'Pop' and 'Click' digital UI SFX trigger as text boxes appear and disappear on the timeline. (7) The BGM maintains a consistent upbeat tempo throughout, providing a continuous rhythmic bed under the uninterrupted, fast-paced narration. (8) Small 'Ding' bells and 'Whoosh' sounds punctuate transitions between technical diagrams and live-action laboratory footage.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To explain the physics principle of the Froude Number and how it allows engineers at the Ocean Engineering Center in Kaohsiung to simulate massive ocean forces using small-scale models, thereby saving costs and improving safety for offshore wind turbines.
